Instructions Teleports Skill Points Full walkthrough
Click a red pin chip (e.g. Fort #51) to flash that NPC on the map — orange chips like Forsaken Fort #m7 are monsters. A → /cargo → arrow means use that command to teleport there. Tick Done to hide a finished quest — you can always see completed quests under the All Quests tab. Your progress auto-saves in this browser.

Useful Teleports

6 doggebi scattered around the world will teleport you straight to handy leveling areas — not tied to any quest, just worth knowing about. Click a pin chip to find it on the map, same as any NPC.
